Cross-runtime job-queue test fails on POST handling; agent debugs content-type handling and re-runs the write/read/jobs test with correct CT.

reasoning: The agent reliably returns to the reference when a diff appears, re-derives true behavior, and re-verifies after fixes (well above the level-5 anchor). Several fixes are class/design-level with subsystem re-verification (halt handling, protection modules, latency), matching level-8 behaviors. It stops short of level 10 because there is no evidence of a decisive approach/library swap forced by an inability to reach parity, and no explicit cross-subsystem behavioral-model/plan revision; hence a 7 between the 5 and 8 anchors.
